svg.font-family: Inter, Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: Faded = not set on this layer, falls through to Base. Dashed = nothing. Knobs: turn only (↺ left / ↻ right), the click does nothing; their shortcuts sit on the key below.
Rule: the knob opposite the thumb you're holding does that layer's main job.
typing · home-row mods: Super Alt Ctrl Shift on A S D F, mirrored on ; L K J
hold Esc (left thumb) · arrows, scroll, tabs, back/forward, media, mouse
hold right middle thumb · brackets on the home row, shifted digits on top
hold Enter (left thumb) · numpad on the right, F-keys on the left
hold left outer thumb · workspaces on top, windows below, panels on the inner keys
